subject: Sequencing & MAP for Polaris Diagnostics pilot: MSA / DPA / Order form cadence
messages:
From: Sarah Mendez <sarah.mendez@polarisdx.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: sequencing & milestone plan for MSA/DPA/order form (Polaris DX pilot)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo — the pilot feedback loop looks promising. Procurement and legal here want a concise sequencing plan (MAP) we can use to coordinate our internal approvals and external reviews. Our immediate ask: a clear critical path that shows when we expect a clean MSA, DPA, and final order form so we can align SOW kick-off and PO timing.

High-level constraints from our side:
- Procurement requires an approved PO before provisioning (target PO date: 2028-06-03).
- Legal prefers to return redlines within 7–10 business days once they receive a team-ready MSA.
- Security will do a short follow-up on the DPA; if you provide a standard template we can expedite.

Can you: 1) share a draft MAP with milestones + owners, 2) indicate whether Redwood can deliver a clean MSA by 2028-05-15 and a DPA draft by 2028-05-22, and 3) confirm who at Redwood owns procurement coordination?

Attaching the pilot SOW for context. Also happy to take a 30-min call to walk dependencies next week.

Thanks,
Sarah

--
Sarah Mendez
Head of Procurement
Polaris Diagnostics
[Attachment: Polaris_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mendez <sarah.mendez@polarisdx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: sequencing & milestone plan for MSA/DPA/order form (Polaris DX pilot)

Sarah — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the SOW. Appreciated.

We can put together a mutual action plan that highlights the critical path and parallel-review options to compress the timeline. Quick answers up front: we can target a Redwood clean MSA by 2028-05-15 and a DPA draft by 2028-05-22, provided we run legal review in parallel with your team and Polaris can commit to 7 business-day turnarounds on redlines. Procurement coordination will be handled by Marissa; Vanessa will own the security/DPA touchpoints.

I'll attach an initial MAP (spreadsheet) that lays out milestones, owners, blockers, and suggested fallbacks if timelines slip. If Polaris is comfortable doing parallel review (MSA + DPA + SOW concurrently) we can target order form execution the first week of June. Otherwise, if you require sequential signoff, add ~2 weeks to the end date.

Proposed next step: 30 minutes on Tue 2028-05-04 to confirm owners and agree on a parallel vs sequential cadence.

Preliminary MAP highlights (from our side):
- 2028-05-05: Redwood legal to circulate MSA clean copy (owner: Redwood Legal via Karthik).
- 2028-05-15: Polaris legal to return redlines / approval (owner: Polaris Legal).
- 2028-05-22: Redwood to produce DPA draft and security questionnaire (owner: Vanessa).
- 2028-05-29: Finalize order form; docs to DocuSign (owner: Marissa).
- 2028-06-03: Target PO date on Polaris side for provisioning.

Attachment: MAP-draft-polaris.xlsx (workbook with milestone sheet).

—Karthik

[Attachment: MAP-draft-polaris.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

- Linda (procurement) confirms the PO target is flexible to an extent but needs the MAP to show exact gating items (order form + SOC attestation required for PO approval).

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Polaris MAP - owners & critical-path (internal)

Team — looping you both for action items and to lock owners. Chat notes and next steps below (this is the internal cadence doc before we send a polished MAP back to Polaris).

Summary of constraints from Polaris:
- Procurement needs the MAP to show gating items (order form, SOC attestation) before PO approval.
- Legal wants a tracked MSA with change-log; Polaris legal will aim for a 7–10 business day turn.

Proposed internal plan (short):
1) Draft MSA (Redwood) — deliver 2028-05-05 (Karthik owns)
   - Include change-log and a short cover note summarizing non-standard clauses.
2) Polaris returns redlines — target 2028-05-15
3) Redwood reviews redlines and proposes resolution — target 2028-05-19
4) DPA & security questionnaire shared — deliver 2028-05-22 (Vanessa owns)
5) Order form finalized and sent to DocuSign — target 2028-05-29 (Marissa owns)

Parallelization notes (to compress by ~10 business days):
- If Polaris legal agrees to run MSA and DPA reviews concurrently, and procurement accepts a conditional PO that references the signed order form and pending SOC attestation, we can keep provisioning by ~2028-06-03.

Action items for this thread: 
- Marissa: confirm whether Redwood legal should include standard PO language in the order form to help procurement.
- Vanessa: prepare DPA template (Redwood-Standard-DPA-v2.docx) and a short guidance doc for Polaris security reviewers.
- Karthik: publish the MAP spreadsheet to HubSpot and include links in the external MAP we send tomorrow.

Links / refs:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4832
- Proposed DocuSign envelope (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABC-Polaris-4832

I'll draft the external-facing MAP after you confirm owners; plan to send to Polaris before the Tue meeting.

Thanks,
Karthik

[Attachment: Redwood-Standard-DPA-v2.docx (DOCX, 120KB); MAP-draft-polaris.xlsx attached previously]

From: Sarah Mendez <sarah.mendez@polarisdx.com>

Subject: Re: Sequencing & MAP for Polaris Diagnostics pilot: MSA / DPA / Order form cadence

Karthik / Marissa / Vanessa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft plan. We spoke internally and can commit to the parallel review approach. Confirming the milestone dates below which we will cascade to our approvers: 

- 2028-05-05: Redwood MSA clean copy received
- 2028-05-15: Polaris legal returns redlines
- 2028-05-22: Redwood delivers DPA + security questionnaire answers
- 2028-05-29: Order form into DocuSign for signature
- 2028-06-03: Target PO completion / provisioning window

We will:
- David (cc) will accept a tracked MSA and aims to turn it within 7 business days after receipt.
- Linda (cc) will use the MAP to approve an internal conditional PO that references the DocuSign order form and pending SOC attestation.

Meeting confirmed for Tue 2028-05-04 10:00 AM PT to walk through the MAP and owners (invite sent).

Appreciate your flexibility on parallelization — that should keep our pilot on schedule.

Best,
Sarah

--

Head of Procurement, Polaris Diagnostics
